meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law foundation with French civil law influences, codified under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], Companies Act No. 9 of 2023, and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2017)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Vanuatu and Australia
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Vanuatu and New Zealand
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Vanuatu and the United States

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 12 of 2021 establishing the Beneficial Ownership Register regime); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2017 (as amended); Companies Act No. 9 of 2023; Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap. 70]; VFSC Beneficial Ownership Filing Directives and AML/CFT Rulebook 2021

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed registered agent in Vanuatu with notarized execution pages

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (for non-Hague countries)

Bank reference letter confirming good conduct of the bank account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy attached to apostilled bundle

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Vanuatu registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the principal's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every director, shareholder, UBO, and authorized signatory against (i) the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit PEP database and VFSC prohibited/disqualified persons register; (ii) the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iii) OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists; (iv) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; and (v) Interpol Red Notices. Enhanced due diligence under sections 50-54 of the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2017 is triggered upon any PEP, sanctions, or adverse media match, requiring written source-of-funds documentation, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: VFSC Electronic Company Registry (e-Registry) – online name reservation module administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be submitted in Latin-script Roman characters. English and French are the official statutory languages; Bislama is a recognized national language. Foreign-script names, including Chinese trading names, must be rendered as an approved English or French transliteration; the original foreign script may appear only as a supplementary trading name registered after incorporation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A formal administrative appeal must be lodged in writing with the VFSC Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, stating the legal grounds and attaching a letter of consent or non-objection from the relevant minister or statutory regulator where a sensitive token is involved. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 21 working days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may either re-reserve an amended name (a new statutory fee applies) or file a judicial review application in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 28 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements do not satisfy the statutory registered office and registered agent requirement under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. Every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Port Vila, Vanuatu, at the premises of a VFSC-licensed registered agent. A virtual or home-office back office is acceptable only for the administrative business operations of the social commerce undertaking, not for the statutory registered address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate; approximately 15-20% annual probability of a scheduled or unannounced VFSC on-site compliance inspection. The risk materially increases if the registered office address hosts more than 50 International Companies or if the registered agent is subject to AML/CFT enforcement action by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC online name reservation and name clearance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under VFSC fee schedule

Notarization, apostille, and consular legalization bundle

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Act No. 32 of 1992), as amended, ss. 8-18 (incorporation), s. 24 (registered office), ss. 31-38 (directors and secretary), s. 141 (tax-exempt status); complemented by the Companies Act [Cap 191] for matters recognized by Part 20 of the International Companies Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registration Division, International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1), together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association, notice of registered office, and consent forms of director/secretary and registered agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed. The Memorandum must state the authorized share capital; at least one issued share is required and shares may be denominated in any freely convertible currency. No statutory escrow account, capital deposit, or paid-up subscription obligation is imposed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: 1. The subscriber hereby subscribes to the initial fifty ordinary shares of no par value, said shares being fully issued to the subscriber in accordance with the Statement of Shares filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. 2. The registered office of the Company shall be located at the registered agent’s office, as notified to the VFSC Registry. 3. [Director Name] is appointed sole Director, and [Secretary Name] is appointed Secretary as required under the International Companies Act. 4. Any director or Secretary is authorised to execute and file the incorporation documents, and to instruct the registered agent to obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and to open bank or payment-account facilities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC eServices Portal and International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name availability check with the proposed company name; pay the relevant search fee and obtain a Name Reservation Certificate valid for 30 days. Ensure the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company, trademark, or protected government phrase.
required_dossiers: Passport or government-issued ID copy of proposed beneficial owner/shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried, submit a written request to the VFSC Registration Division within 10 business days proposing an amended distinctive name or providing evidence of prior trademark rights; the Registry will issue a determinative decision within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and notary public in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act, stating authorized share capital, share classes, restrictions (if any), and permitted objects. Execute documents before a notary public and obtain apostille certification for any foreign-issued corporate resolutions or passport copies.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of Shares and initial shareholder registry
Consent and appointment letter of director
Consent and appointment letter of secretary
Notarized ID/proof of address of director, secretary, and shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry or registered agent requires amendments to constitutive documents, execute a supplemental Deed of Adherence or amended memorandum/Articles and resubmit; no re-notarization is needed unless the change affects a signature page.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registration Division, International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1, the notarized constitutional documents, and the notices of registered office and registered agent. Pay the government incorporation fee and annual registration fee via bank transfer or electronic payment to the VFSC account, and obtain a payment receipt referencing the application number.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 duly signed by the subscriber or registered agent
Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent (Form IC-2)
Consent forms for director and secretary
Statement of first director and secretary
Proof of payment of VFSC fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the registered agent receives a VFSC notice identifying deficiencies; the agent must correct the documents and resubmit within 14 days. If the deadline is missed, the application is deemed abandoned and fees may be forfeited unless a written extension is granted by the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Incorporation Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registration Division and licensed financial intermediary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon final approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation recording the company number, date of registration, and registered office. The registered agent then files the initial register of directors, secretary, shareholders, and charges; the company may thereafter open corporate bank accounts, obtain a business identification number, and commence lawful offshore transactions.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Memorandum and Articles of Association (stamped by VFSC)
Bank account opening package (permission to operate resolution and passport copies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains any discrepancy (name, number, date), submit a written rectification request to VFSC within 10 business days; the Registry will re-issue an amended certificate within 2 business days. For banking rejection, engage an alternative licensed financial intermediary and submit the full corporate pack to satisfy enhanced due diligence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Tourism, Trade, Commerce and Ni-Vanuatu Business — Department of Industry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating licence in Vanuatu for offshore social-media live-commerce retail conducted through TikTok Shop; a Vanuatu International Company is prohibited from carrying on local business and therefore no local business licence shall be obtained.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — full EIA requirement does not arise because the activity is entirely digital/online with no physical establishment, discharge, extraction, or land disturbance in Vanuatu.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to pure online trading. If the company later establishes any storage or fulfilment facility, it must comply with the Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations 2018, the National Environment Policy Act 2015, and the Clean Air Act 2015, including VOC/particulate thresholds for any equipment installed; no point-source wastewater discharge is permitted without a Trade Waste Permit from Port Vila Municipal Council or the relevant provincial authority.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety, structural load, or workplace clearance is required for a purely remote home-office operation. Should an office or warehouse be established in Vanuatu, the company must obtain a Certificate of Occupancy from the Public Works Department, fire clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service, and a workplace health inspection under the Employment Act 2010 and the Occupational Health and Safety regulations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) for domestic fiscal matters; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) as the registry authority for International Companies (portal at https://www.vfsc.vu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign shareholders incorporate an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] through a VFSC-licensed registered agent. The VFSC issues a Certificate of Incorporation bearing a unique company registration number. No separate TIN or VAT registration number is issued because an IC is expressly exempt from all Vanuatu national taxes; the only recurring fiscal obligation is the annual VFSC license fee payable through the registered agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists. An IC may voluntarily elect to redomicile or convert to a domestic company under the Companies Act [Cap 191], thereby forfeiting the tax-exempt regime and becoming subject to standard Vanuatu taxation. No other statutory elective classification mechanism applies.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST in force (a 12.5% VAT was legislatively scheduled but repeatedly deferred; not effective for this assessment)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST regime is currently in force; a proposed future VAT would apply to taxable supplies above VUV 10,000,000 annual turnover, but the legislation is not yet operative.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API data exchange, or digital stamping requirement exists in Vanuatu. International Companies are not connected to any national e-invoicing mesh or fiscal telemetry system; private commercial records are sufficient.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — absent a VAT/GST regime, there is no zero-rating mechanism to claim. An International Company's offshore income, including TikTok Shop retail sales proceeds, is categorically outside Vanuatu's tax jurisdiction and generates zero output tax liability and zero refund entitlement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (only if physical goods transit Vanuatu customs territory)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (for physical logistics corridors)
Platform settlement report from TikTok Shop Payout or Wise B2B evidencing inward remittance
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No statutory FX repatriation deadline or VAT clawback exists because Vanuatu has no exchange controls and ICs are fully tax-exempt. However, false declarations or misuse of the International Company regime are prosecuted under the International Companies Act and VFSC enforcement rules; penalties include fines up to VUV 500,000, deregistration, director disqualification, and retrospective revocation of tax-exempt status if the company engages in prohibited domestic business activity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) as the Central Bank and Foreign Exchange Control Authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 155], with day-to-day exchange control administration delegated to Authorized Dealer Banks (ADBs); the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately licenses International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is convertible on current and capital account; Vanuatu maintains a liberal exchange control regime with no general restrictions on non-resident transactions. Qualifying International Companies dealing in foreign currency with non-residents are substantially exempt from exchange control formalities. Inward capital subscriptions and outward profit remittances are permitted without prior RBV approval, but banks require documentary proof of IC good standing, registered agent confirmation, beneficial ownership declarations, and appropriate SWIFT purpose codes. VUV operates under a managed-trade-weighted-basket arrangement, so USD/AUD/EUR-denominated treasury accounts are recommended to avoid ADB conversion spreads. Profit remittance hurdles are minimal for the tax-exempt IC, but each outbound transfer is subject to the ADB's sanctions, anti-money-laundering, and source-of-funds screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no required repatriation timeline. Exporters and cross-border e-commerce operators, including International Companies, may retain foreign currency export proceeds indefinitely in foreign currency accounts at Authorized Dealer Banks and convert to VUV only as needed at commercial rates. An IC may not transact with Vanuatu residents unless domestically licensed, so VUV conversion should generally be avoided for treasury efficiency.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD/AUD/EUR); Capital Escrow Account available
Operational Account (USD/AUD/EUR); Capital Escrow Account available
Operational Account (USD/EUR); Capital Escrow Account available
Operational Account (VUV/USD); Capital Escrow Account available

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Vanuatu has no dedicated e-money institution licensing regime; deposit-taking and cross-border remittance services require authorization under the Financial Institutions Act 1999 and notification to the RBV or VFSC. Globally licensed digital payment providers such as Wise Platform, Payoneer, or Airwallex are not locally regulated in Vanuatu but may on-board the VU IC as a corporate customer through their offshore licensed affiliates via virtual account rails. Legal constraints include the absence of local passporting, Vanuatu AML duties under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act requiring beneficial ownership disclosure, and issuer risk appetite toward opaque offshore entities. Wise B2B is viable as the primary TikTok Shop payout collection rail, provided the IC retains a domestic ADB operational account as the fallback clearing and settlement layer.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of at least one director, an authorized signatory, or a delegation to the licensed registered agent is typically required for the corporate account opening interview at Vanuatu ADBs. Remote opening is not generally available for newly formed ICs; banks require either an in-person visit or a video-based interview where the IC is introduced by a licensed registered agent, with original or notarized passports, director proof of address, certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, certificate of good standing, registered agent confirmation, beneficial ownership declaration, and a board resolution appointing signatories and defining account purpose. The prudent default is a physical visit to the ADB or a notarized signatory pack executed through the registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer share capital structure or unverified beneficial ownership disclosure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent attestation, certificate of incumbency, complete beneficial ownership registry declaration identifying all natural-person shareholders above 10%, written confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding or a licensed-custodian custody letter if permitted, memorandum and articles of association, and five-year ownership history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume social commerce with micro-transactions to and from numerous third-party marketplace accounts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed TikTok Shop merchant agreement, platform KYC and payout statements evidencing settlement in the IC's name, monthly volume and jurisdiction forecasts, merchant bank verification, sample payout files, and a documented transaction flow from TikTok Shop settlement to the ADB operational account and onward to vetted suppliers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No physical office or staff in Vanuatu and circular payment flows through the registered agent
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered office lease or licensed-agent service agreement, operating center documentation in the supplier market, corporate organizational chart, treasury mandate authorizing payments only to named suppliers, and sanctions and politically-exposed-persons screening results for all counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of wealth for initial capital injection not adequately supported
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder bank statements showing the source of injected funds, underlying e-commerce revenue records or asset sale agreements, statutory declarations of source of wealth, tax records from the shareholder's residence jurisdiction, and board resolution confirming equity capitalization rather than informal lending.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital is injected via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for interbank credit) to the IC's USD, AUD, or EUR account at an Authorized Dealer Bank, with the payment narrative stating 'Equity injection and paid-in capital to International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]'. The remitting bank must supply a funds-origin declaration, and the receiving ADB will verify the source of wealth, corporate good standing, and registered agent confirmation. No prior RBV approval is required for a qualifying IC; the ADB records the inflow in its exchange-control reporting. To avoid recharacterization risks, the IC should maintain capital escrow and operating sub-ledgers and keep shareholder loans in separately documented loan agreements with stated interest terms, notwithstanding the IC's tax exemption.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier and logistics payments are cleared through ADB-originated SWIFT MT103 wires in USD, GBP, or EUR. For TikTok Shop affiliate commissions and repeat supplier settlements, batch API-driven payout rails such as Wise B2B or Payoneer Payouts are permissible where the IC's merchant settlement account is the documented originator and beneficiary accounts are on a pre-approved supplier list. For high-value inventory procurement above approximately USD 50,000, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit at sight or usance, issued through the ADB and advised or confirmed by a correspondent bank in the supplier's jurisdiction, is the preferred clearing rail. Same-currency sweeping between the TikTok Shop settlement account and the ADB operational account minimizes FX exposure; crypto rails, informal value transfer systems, and commingled personal accounts are prohibited by treasury policy.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV deliverable outright forwards from 10 days to 12 months with an Authorized Dealer Bank
USD/VUV non-deliverable forwards with an offshore counterparty where onshore VUV liquidity is unavailable or the ADB cannot quote competitive onshore tenors
AUD/USD and EUR/USD vanilla FX swaps and foreign-exchange options offered by Authorized Dealer Banks for multi-currency treasury management
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps limited to ancillary hedging of any bank financing, subject to RBV exchange-control reporting
Same-currency balance sheet netting through segregated USD, AUD, and EUR accounts to avoid repeated VUV conversion

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Licence Fee Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 calendar days following each anniversary of incorporation; annual government fee payable with the annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 10% of the annual fee is imposed immediately after the 60-day filing window; continued default beyond 6 months empowers the Registrar to administratively strike the company off the International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the licensed international company service provider
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the anniversary annual return; registered office address and resident agent details must be current at all times
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Material non-compliance constitutes an offence under the International Companies Act carrying penalties of up to VT 1,000,000; persistent breach exposes the entity to strike-off proceedings and disqualification of directors.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); register physically maintained at the registered office in Vanuatu
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Register updated on a real-time basis and certified within the anniversary annual return; shareholder changes must be recorded within 30 days of any transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or update the beneficial ownership register subjects the company and its directors to VFSC penalty notices; aggravated default supports administrative strike-off and director disqualification under the Companies (Amendment) Act.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act, irrespective of turnover or assets, unless the entity holds a regulated financial services licence (banking, insurance, securities) or the directors elect an audit by ordinary resolution.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies are statutorily exempt from preparing or filing financial statements with VFSC; IFRS may be adopted voluntarily for internal record-keeping, but no local GAAP filing obligation arises.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The register of beneficial owners must be held at the VFSC-approved registered office and verified during the annual return cycle; share transfers require director consent recording, prompt update of the Register of Members, and refresh of the beneficial ownership register within 30 days; nominee, trust, or similar arrangements must be disclosed to the resident agent for accurate UBO certification.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (audit not mandated); optional certified audit USD 2,500 – 5,000 if elected

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or branch profits tax at the national level; International Companies registered under the International Companies Act, Cap. 222 are expressly exempt from all present and future taxes on income, profits, and distributions.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 100% statutory exemption for International Companies and their operations; no VAT, goods and services tax, or payroll tax applies to an IC's offshore business; municipal business license fees apply only if the IC maintains a physical commercial presence in Port Vila or Luganville for local retail activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return for International Companies — filed electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) eServices Portal or via the licensed registered agent; there is no income tax return form in Vanuatu because no corporate income tax regime exists.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within one calendar month of each anniversary of the company's date of incorporation (International Companies Act, Cap. 222, annual return provision).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique VFSC registration number assigned at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must verify the number from the Certificate of Incorporation; no resident agent co-signature is required beyond the appointed registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B — Registered Office Address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The official address for legal service of process, which must be maintained in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent supplies the regulated physical address; non-resident directors must not list a foreign address as the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C — Directors and Shareholders Particulars
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, nationality, and shareholding percentages of all directors and members.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC law allows wholly non-resident ownership and directorship; a confidential register of beneficial owners is maintained by the registered agent but not publicly filed in most cases.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, including par value and classes of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital requirement applies; the statement should reflect the actual issued capital, which may be denominated in any currency other than Vatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the company has complied with IC Act filing and record-keeping obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Vanuatu-licensed registered agent executes the certification; non-resident principals should ensure all underlying KYC and substance records are supplied before this box is signed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgement of the VFSC Annual Return attracts a prescribed late filing fee of VT 10,000 for the first three months of delay and VT 25,000 thereafter; persistent non-filing permits VFSC to strike the International Company off the register, forfeiting its corporate legal personality and tax-exempt status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business License Renewal Application — Lodged with the Municipal Council or the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue for physical retail premises; applicable only if the IC carries on retail operations within Vanuatu territory rather than purely offshore e-commerce.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Renewal applications must be submitted on or before 31 December for the following calendar year under the Business Licences Act, Cap. 243.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Business Name and Trade Name
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal IC name and any trading name used on TikTok Shop storefront.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign IC trading purely offshore without a Vanuatu storefront does not complete this return; the TikTok Shop seller registration should instead mirror the IC's legal name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of any shop, warehouse, or office physically located in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no Vanuatu premises and no local employees exist, the IC qualifies as outside the scope of the Business Licences Act and pays no license fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Projected gross revenue for the license year used to calculate the license fee tier.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only revenue generated by Vanuatu-resident customers or through a Vanuatu physical operation is declarable; offshore TikTok Shop sales are excluded from the fee base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the trade category corresponding to ISIC 4791 / retail sale via e-commerce platforms.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Applicants describing social media live-commerce should select the retail e-commerce classification; misclassification as wholesale or services may attract penalty reassessments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature and declaration of accuracy under penalty of fine.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The designated local representative, if any, signs only when a physical Vanuatu operation exists; otherwise filing is not required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Operating a physical Vanuatu business without a valid business license is an offense subject to a fine of up to VT 200,000 plus a continuing daily penalty of VT 2,000; the municipal council may also obtain a court order closing the premises.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu does not impose withholding tax on any distribution, including cash dividends, stock dividends, deemed distributions, or liquidation proceeds paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network currently in force; the former income tax treaties with Australia and New Zealand have been terminated and no replacement treaty provides reduced dividend withholding rates; consequently there is no tax-residency certificate (TRC) application procedure or tax treaty clearance protocol with the Vanuatu Government. Remittance of dividends to foreign shareholders is made without Vanuatu tax clearance or documentary requirement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% on outbound royalties for intellectual property and 0% on debt interest paid to foreign lenders; treaty rate: not applicable as no DTA is in force; no Vanuatu certificate of residence or DTA filing is required for cross-border license or loan agreements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has no domestic transfer pricing legislation, no arm's length statutory rule, and no Vatu-denominated documentation threshold for Master File or Local File; International Companies are exempt from corporate income tax and therefore cannot obtain a tax advantage through artificial transfer pricing.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Comparable Uncontrolled Price (CUP) — accepted where direct market comparables exist
Resale Price Method — suitable for distribution despatched through overseas warehouses
Cost Plus Method — appropriate for service and fulfilment arrangements
Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) — pragmatic fallback when comparables are imperfect
Profit Split Method — used for integrated multi-jurisdiction TikTok Shop group operations
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR), effective for International Companies engaged in relevant activities, require adequate physical presence, local employment, core income-generating activities in Vanuatu, and annual substance reporting to VFSC; a TikTok Shop retail operation substantially conducted from Vanuatu may fall within 'distribution and service centre' scope where purchasing, inventory management, order processing, and logistics functions occur on-island, requiring a local office, staff, and directors' meetings in Vanuatu; purely offshore sellers without Vanuatu operational substance must nonetheless document that their relevant activities are not attributable to Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Offshore Tax Fraud Abroad
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC and its foreign beneficial owners deliberately fail to disclose the TikTok Shop business to their country of tax residence, interpose nominee directors to conceal control, and repatriate sales revenue as tax-free distributions to evade foreign income tax; Vanuatu's 0% regime is abused as an artificial avoidance structure rather than a genuine commercial platform.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu has no domestic income tax to sanction, but the foreign resident jurisdiction may impose tax fraud penalties, civil fraud fines of up to 200% of understated tax, criminal prosecution, and joint liability orders; Vanuatu authorities may also cooperate through exchange of information arrangements, exposing the structure to cross-border enforcement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors and beneficial owners acting as de facto or shadow directors face personal liability for fraudulent trading, foreign criminal tax penalties, and confiscation orders; travel bans may be issued by the foreign tax authority and judicial freezing orders may pierce the Vanuatu corporate veil on grounds of sham or façade.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the International Company as a letterbox vehicle with no employees, no office, no independent decision-making, and no substantive TikTok Shop operational nexus in Vanuatu while claiming Vanuatu as the sole tax jurisdiction; failure to file the annual ESR declaration or to meet the economic substance test for a relevant activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the ESR framework, VFSC may levy administrative penalties for non-compliance, file a notice to strike off the company, and recommend cessation of business activities; on international review lists, such failures precipitate defensive countermeasures including withholding surcharges imposed on payments to Vanuatu entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for ESR penalty debts where they authorized false substance declarations; a director may also be disqualified from holding office in Vanuatu for up to five years and the registered agent may terminate its agency, causing automatic deregistration and loss of limited liability protection.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breaches and Unlicensed Financial Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the TikTok Shop as a pass-through for third-party funds, processing customer payments through the IC's Wise B2B account for unrelated parties, receiving cryptocurrency proceeds from unverified sellers, or engaging in money-value transfer activity without obtaining a VFSC AML/CFT compliance program and licensed agent supervision.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu anti-money laundering legislation, administered by VFSC, imposes fines of up to VT 50,000,000 or more for serious compliance failures and criminal sanctions for money laundering where the underlying funds derive from predicate offenses; the IC's bank and payment rail accounts may be frozen and the entity may be suspended.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers can be criminally prosecuted for enabling unlicensed money services business activity, face imprisonment of up to 12 years under Vanuatu money laundering provisions, and may be ordered to pay restitution from personal assets; international asset tracing can reach foreign property of the shareholders via veil-piercing remedies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Filings and Fraudulent Misrepresentation to VFSC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a knowingly false annual return, concealing the identity of the true beneficial owner of the TikTok Shop, providing fictitious share capital statements, or using the registered agent to file forged shareholder consents and board resolutions to obtain or maintain ICS registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act, a person who knowingly makes a false statement in a document required by the Act commits an offense punishable by a fine not exceeding VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years; the company is subject to deregistration and its exemption certificate may be revoked retroactively.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Offending directors and beneficial owners acting behind nominees face criminal imprisonment, disqualification orders, and civil restitution to defrauded creditors; the corporate veil is pierced entirely when the IC is used as a vehicle for fraud, permitting direct attachment of personal accounts and denial of limited liability.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Cross-Border Tax Reporting and Information Exchange Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately failing to report the IC as a controlled foreign entity in the beneficial owner's tax residence, failing to disclose economic ownership under Common Reporting Standard exchange channels, or structuring ownership through bearer shares and undisclosed nominees purely to defeat tax authority transparency.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The foreign residence country may apply controlled foreign corporation anti-avoidance rules to impute all TikTok Shop profits to the individual regardless of the 0% Vanuatu rate, issue penalty assessments, and initiate mutual assistance procedures via Vanuatu's exchange of information agreements; Vanuatu's VFSC complies with competent authority requests for accounting records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The beneficial owner who exercises real control without being named as a director remains personally accountable as a shadow director; foreign civil courts may order worldwide asset disclosure, freezing orders against personal holdings, passport surrender, and imprisonment for contempt where the taxpayer frustrates tax collection.
